error_message: Hardcoded 1.0/60.0 frame time throughout codebase — FlashTimer -= 1.0/60.0, all timers assume 60 FPS; physics break on any other framerate
root_cause: All time-based calculations use literal 1.0/60.0 instead of delta time; on 144Hz monitors or vsync-off displays the game runs 2.4x faster, on 30 FPS devices it runs 2x slower
prevention_rule: PREVENT-TD-001: Never hardcode frame time — use Ebiten's delta time (1.0/ebiten.MaxTPS() or actual elapsed time per frame)

error_message: O(n*m) enemy targeting — every tower iterates all enemies every frame, causing severe lag with many towers and enemies
root_cause: Each tower's Update() method loops over the entire enemy slice to find targets; with 50 towers and 200 enemies this is 10,000 iterations per frame, 600,000 per second at 60 FPS
prevention_rule: PREVENT-TD-002: Use spatial partitioning (grid, quadtree) for enemy targeting — never linear scan all enemies per tower per frame

error_message: 15K assets for a tower defense game is excessive — bloated repo, slow builds, long load times
root_cause: Asset directory contains ~15,000 files (sprites, sounds, fonts, maps) far exceeding what a tower defense game needs; likely includes unused assets, duplicate resolutions, or unoptimized atlases
prevention_rule: PREVENT-TD-003: Audit asset directory — remove unused assets, pack sprites into atlases, use compressed audio formats

error_message: No spatial partitioning — all game entities scanned linearly for collision, targeting, and area effects
root_cause: Game has no grid, quadtree, or any spatial data structure; all entity interactions use O(n) or O(n²) scans
prevention_rule: PREVENT-TD-004: Implement spatial grid or quadtree for entity queries — O(1) neighbor lookup instead of O(n) scan

error_message: Fixed timestep assumption breaks on non-60 FPS displays — game speed varies with monitor refresh rate
root_cause: Game assumes 60 FPS everywhere; Update() functions use frame-count-based logic instead of delta time; Ebiten's TPS is not used for time calculations
prevention_rule: PREVENT-TD-005: Use Ebiten's actual delta time or fixed TPS — never assume 60 FPS in game logic
